summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a routine Form 6-K attaching a press release, dated November 11, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary LightSolver will publicly demonstrate its all-optical Laser Processing Unit at SC26 in Chicago on November 16-19, 2026, including Boeing corrosion-simulation work and a Birds of a Feather analog-computing session. No transaction terms, ownership changes, board recommendations, advisors, or regulatory clocks are disclosed. This is an ordinary product/technology announcement, not a special situation; watch for commercial milestones rather than deal mechanics.
